title: Polynomial Transition Formula Cost
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $C,n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. If the coefficient $|\mathrm{State}(M)|+6k+5$ is at most $C$, then the transition CNF cost is at most $2^k$ times the number of transition cases, times $2^{3k+7}(3k+8)$, times $C(s+n+2)^{k+2}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
